stem_md: $(y\cos x-x\sin x)dx+(y\sin x+x\cos x)dy=0$ 的积分因子是（ ）
analysis_md:
$$
P(x,y)=y\cos x-x\sin x,\quad Q(x,y)=y\sin x+x\cos x,
$$

$$
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=-y\cos x+x\sin x,
$$

$$
\frac{1}{-P}\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}\right)=1,
$$

故积分因子为 $\mu(y)=e^{\int 1\,dy}=e^y,$
